responsibility: Declares the source-file caching API used by diagnostics and some front ends. It defines char_span as a bounds-aware view of source bytes and file_cache as the service that can load or inject source content, return individual lines or entire files, report trailing-newline status, and tune or evict cache entries, forming the public interface over the slot-based implementation in file-cache.cc.
same_name_distinction: This header is the public interface for the file-cache pair: it declares the char_span view type and the file_cache operations for loading, injecting, querying, tuning, and evicting source content. Unlike file-cache.cc, it does not define the slot-based cache machinery, file-reading algorithms, or selftests.
